name: holdout_detector_disjoint_v4
description:
Detector-disjoint holdout subset v4 — 10 cases. Extends v3 (9 cases) with natcomm_nguyen_mirna (provenance_mismatch: Fig7f used data from wrong experiment). All cases: anomaly types NOT covered by the duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse detector family. All discovered via correction notices or PubPeer. Use to test whether B3 FAR generalises beyond detector training distribution.

Anomaly type breakdown (7 distinct types across 10 cases):
  label_swap x2:                        ncb_cav2, natcomm_florido_tac2
  misaligned_records:                    ncb_clonalfish
  mislabeled_panel:                      ncb_lphn3
  assignment_inconsistency x2:           ncb_radioligand, ncb_nickelate
  pseudoreplication:                     ncb_spp1
  provenance_mismatch x2:               elife_neurexin_fig1b, natcomm_nguyen_mirna
  figure_vs_sourcedata_count_mismatch:   natcomm_petruk_tlr

This suite meets the 10-case minimum target for the detector-disjoint holdout.
